messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need to lock the rerank API behavior for launch. Key open items: score normalization, stable sorting, truncation policy, and sensible defaults for top_k. Several customers asked for deterministic outputs across upgrades. Thoughts?

oliver: For normalization we should offer two modes: `none` (raw logits) and `calibrated` (softmax or min-max to 0-1). Softmax is nice for comparison across candidate sets but is sensitive to candidate count/scale. Min-max is simpler and more interpretable to product teams.

kevin: Implementation note: softmax requires exponentiation per-request which is trivial cost-wise, but we need deterministic ties handling. Also we should avoid normalizing across huge candidate lists in a blocking way — stream-friendly incremental normalization is harder.

jess: API proposal sketch (defaults chosen for safety):
```http
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "query": "How do I reset my password?",
  "candidates": [{"id":"c1","text":"..."}, {"id":"c2","text":"..."}],
  "top_k": 5,              // default: 10 if omitted
  "normalize_scores": "calibrated", // enum: none | calibrated
  "calibration_method": "minmax",   // enum: minmax | softmax | zscore
  "truncate_policy": "per_candidate", // enum: per_candidate | global_budget
  "stable_sort": true,    // break ties deterministically by id
  "return_scores": true
}
```
(We should keep defaults conservative: top_k=10, calibrated=minmax, truncate=per_candidate)

sam: On truncation: customers care about fairness when candidates vary in length. Per_candidate truncation (cap each candidate at N tokens) is easiest to reason about. Global_budget is more cost-efficient but non-deterministic across result sets. For launch, per_candidate wins.

oliver: Calibration detail — minmax across candidates is deterministic but sensitive to outliers. Softmax smooths extremes but makes scores dependent on temperature. We could expose `temperature` when `calibration_method=softmax`. Also add `scale_to_01` boolean for teams that want 0-1 output from logits post-calibration.

kevin: Stable sorting: default `stable_sort=true` and tie-breaker is candidate id lexicographic. Add a `seed` param if customers want randomized tie-breaks. Implementation: compute (score, id) and sort (score desc, id asc).

maria: Launch criteria suggestion:
- Accuracy/regression: NDCG@10 on our canonical eval set must be >= current prod + no >1% regressions across customer-critical queries.
- Latency: P95 <= 180ms for top_k=10 in hosted config.
- Cost: median token-cost per request <= target X (TBD).
- Safety: no change to normalization default without deprecation cycle.
- Observability: per-request score distribution logs + feature to compare before/after (model upgrade diffs).

jess: Canary plan: 1% traffic with canary model + `normalize_scores` feature flag. Monitor NDCG, user-reported regressions, latency. Auto-fallback to previous model on increase in error or +5% latency.

sam: One more edge: embeddings blending. Some customers will combine similarity embeddings with model rerank scores. We should document recommended pipeline: normalize both streams to 0-1 and then weighted sum, or expose a `blend` helper param: `{embedding_weight: 0.4, model_weight: 0.6}` so we do consistent scaling server-side.

oliver: Agree. Provide a default blending doc snippet and a small calibration endpoint for customers to fit weights on a labeled set. That reduces integration churn.

kevin: Action items:
- kevin: implement minmax + softmax calibration, stable_sort, per_candidate truncation, tie-break seed support (ETA: 2 sprints)
- oliver: produce calibration guidance + eval scripts and canonical eval set (ETA: next week)
- jess: finalize API spec + docs + examples, include embedding-blend example (ETA: 1 week)
- maria: final signoff after we see eval numbers and latency numbers from kevin's branch

maria: OK folks — do we have consensus on defaults (top_k=10, normalize=minmax, truncate=per_candidate, stable_sort=true)? Reply with :thumbsup: or flag objections.

oliver: :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
jess: :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup:
rerank-bot: Canary created: rerank-v2-calib-canary @ 1%

maria: Great — moving to spec PR. Ill ping when PR is up for review. Thanks!
